links.outcome: LLM accuracy on expert-derived applied surgical anatomy scenarios, including critical errors
links.effect: ChatGPT 250/250, Gemini 248, DeepSeek 241, Copilot 240, Claude 235, Manus 219; one critical error each for DeepSeek, Claude, Manus; ceiling effects limited discrimination.
links.quote: Critical errors were infrequent and were confined to a reconstructive vascular physiology scenario: DeepSeek, Claude, and Manus each demonstrated one observed critical error, whereas ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot demonstrated none.

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance and safety/critical errors of multiple LLMs on 25 expert-derived surgical anatomy scenarios without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
